rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for coating a surface with wax or polish.

example.english: I wax my car every Sunday.
example.traditional: 我每個星期日都幫架車打蠟。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 jat6 dou1 bong1 gaa3 ce1 daa2 laap6

rows.note: Use this specifically when removing body hair from the roots with wax.

example.english: In summer, I usually wax so wearing shorts is easier.
example.traditional: 我夏天通常用蠟脫毛，着短褲方便啲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 haa6 tin1 tung1 soeng4 jung6 laap6 tyut3 mou4 zoek3 dyun2 fu3 fong1 bin6 di1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for wax as a material.

example.english: I bought some wax to make candles.
example.traditional: 我買咗啲蠟返嚟整蠟燭。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 laap6 faan1 lei4 zing2 laap6 zuk1

rows.note: Use this everyday spoken term specifically for wax in the ear.

example.english: You have some wax in your ear.
example.jyutping: nei5 zek3 ji5 zai2 jau5 di1 ji5 si2 wo3

rows.note: Use this for a wax-containing liquid or preparation used to polish surfaces.

example.english: The table is much smoother after I applied wax polish.
example.traditional: 搽咗蠟水之後張枱滑好多。
example.jyutping: caa4 zo2 laap6 seoi2 zi1 hau6 zoeng1 toi2 waat6 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this specifically for wax produced by bees.

example.english: This lip balm is made with wax from bees.
example.traditional: 呢啲護唇膏用蜂蠟整㗎。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 wu6 seon4 gou1 jung6 fung1 laap6 zing2 gaa3
